ability.name: Air Power
ability.note: [CTRL QL Restored Pokémon][Restored Pokémon]. If this Pokémon is not affected by a special condition, it may MP move over Pokémon on the field that don't have [CTRL QL Soar][Soar]. Opposing Pokémon that are not Ghost- or Ground-type Pokémon cannot MP move through this Pokémon using the effect of an Ability. If this Pokémon is on the field, opposing Pokémon cannot use the effect of [CTRL PID 423][Air Balloon] to MP move over other Pokémon.

wheel.name: Sky Drop
wheel.note: This Pokémon moves to a point 2 steps away and gains Wait. If the battle opponent is a non-Flying-type Pokémon, the battle opponent gains Wait 5.

wheel.name: Taunt
wheel.note: Until the end of your next turn, if the Pokémon hit by this Attack spins a Purple Attack or Blue Attack, shift the result clockwise until a non-Purple, non-Blue Attack comes up.
